newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas volatile but only four trades concluded.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas volatile but only four trades concluded.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw only four separate trades done on Tuesday, totalling 115 lots, with most of the volume done in a July/January time spread.

"There just aren't that many orders in the market," a futures broker said. He added that prices had risen in active trade on the physical market, and this had helped to stifle trade on the futures market.

Fifty lots were traded in both July and January in what a broker said was a time spread. July traded up by 3.70 pence a therm to 13.85 pence, a huge jump and far above the price on the physical market, while January fell by over a penny to trade at 14.40 pence.
Other than these two deals, only two trades were recorded all day, a total of 15 lots in April. The last of these deal was done at 10.30 pence, down by 0.050 pence from Monday's settlement.
